title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
summary: Indian equities may consolidate after a sharp 10% rally in seven sessions, with profit booking and global cues likely to dictate near-term direction. While Nifty faces resistance at 25,200, strong earnings prospects, lower crude prices and easing AI capex concerns offer support. FII buying and a stronger rupee add to the positive undertone.

title: Time to shed fear and think positive? 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 33%
summary: Mid-cap stocks tend to move more than large-caps. And that works both ways. They rise faster when the market is rising, and fall harder when it is falling. Keep that in mind as the market’s mood changes for the better because oil prices are dropping and the macro worries responsible for the long sell-off are starting to go away.

title: Stock Radar: BSE stock up over 10% in a month, technical charts hint at a bottom?
summary: BSE Ltd has recently broken out from an inverse head and shoulder pattern, indicating potential upward movement. The stock has previously experienced a correction but found support around Rs 3,000 levels. Experts predict a target above Rs 4,000 in the coming months if the stock sustains above crucial support levels. The daily MACD indicates bullish momentum, while the RSI shows it may still have room for growth.

title: Blackstone to invest Rs 5,000 crore in IIFL Finance for 16% stake as company raises Rs 6,414 crore
summary: IIFL Finance will raise Rs 6,414 crore through a capital infusion led by Blackstone, which will invest Rs 5,000 crore for an approximately 16% stake. Co-promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman will contribute Rs 1,264 crore through warrants, while Anchorage Capital will invest Rs 150 crore.
